mapper.select: /* Attd06Mapper.selectShiftTypeLists */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.SHIFT_CD AS shiftCd , A.SHIFT_NO AS shiftNo , CONCAT(A.SHIFT_TEAM_CNT, '조 ', A.SHIFT_PTRN_CNT, '교대') AS shiftNm , A.SHIFT_PTRN_CNT AS shiftPtrnCnt , A.SHIFT_TEAM_CNT AS shiftTeamCnt , A.SHIFT_CYCLE_DAYS AS shiftCycleDays , A.USE_YN AS useYn , GROUP_CONCAT(B.SCH_NM ORDER BY B.DAY_NO SEPARATOR ' / ') AS schNmList FROM TB_SHIFT_SCH_MGMT A INNER JOIN ( SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.SITE_CD , A.SHIFT_CD , A.TEAM_IDX , A.DAY_NO , A.SCH_CD ,IFNULL(CONCAT(B.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, '~', B.FST_SCH_END_TIME), 'OFF') SCH_NM FROM TB_SHIFT_SCH_ASSIGN_MGMT A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = B.SITE_CD AND A.SCH_CD = B.SCH_CD ) WHERE A.TEAM_IDX = '1' ) B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = B.SITE_CD AND A.SHIFT_CD = B.SHIFT_CD ) WHERE 1=1 AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} GROUP BY A.CMPNY_CD , A.SITE_CD , A.SHIFT_CD , A.SHIFT_NO , A.SHIFT_PTRN_CNT , A.SHIFT_TEAM_CNT , A.SHIFT_CYCLE_DAYS , A.USE_YN

/* Attd06Mapper.selectShiftTypeDetailLists */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.SHIFT_CD AS shiftCd , B.TEAM_IDX AS teamIdx , B.TEAM_NM AS teamNm , B.DAY_NO AS dayNo , B.ASSIGN_YN AS assignYn , B.SCH_CD AS schCd , B.SCH_NO AS schNo , B.FST_SCH_TIME AS fstSchTime , B.SEC_SCH_TIME AS secSchTime , B.SCH_TYPE AS schType FROM TB_SHIFT_SCH_MGMT A INNER JOIN ( SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.SITE_CD , A.SHIFT_CD , A.TEAM_IDX , C.TEAM_NM , A.DAY_NO , A.ASSIGN_YN , A.SCH_CD , B.SCH_NO , CONCAT(B.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, '-', B.FST_SCH_END_TIME) AS FST_SCH_TIME , CASE WHEN SCH_TYPE = '02' THEN CONCAT(B.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, '-', B.SEC_SCH_END_TIME) ELSE NULL END SEC_SCH_TIME , B.SCH_TYPE FROM TB_SHIFT_SCH_ASSIGN_MGMT A INNER JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = B.SITE_CD AND A.SCH_CD = B.SCH_CD ) INNER JOIN TB_SHIFT_SCH_TEAM_META_INFO C ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = C.SITE_CD AND A.SHIFT_CD = C.SHIFT_CD AND A.TEAM_IDX = C.TEAM_IDX ) ) B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = B.SITE_CD AND A.SHIFT_CD = B.SHIFT_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.SHIFT_CD = #{shiftCd}
